Definition: to break off or crunch; figuratively, to deliver
BiblicalUsage: 1) to tear apart or away, tear off, break away; 1a) (Qal) to tear away, snatch, rescue; 1b) (Piel) to tear off; 1c) (Hithpael) to tear off from oneself, be broken off, be broken in pieces
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
